export_model_torchscript: export a ParlAI model to TorchScript format for inference outside of ParlAI
run_torchscript_cli: run the TorchScript export script via CLI with --scripted-model-file and --script-module args
setup_args_torchscript: set up argument parser for TorchScript export with scripted-model-file and input options
run_conversation_scripted: run a conversation with a scripted module using pipe-separated input strings
optimize_inference_torchscript: enable inference optimizations on a TorchScript model using --enable-inference-optimization flag
